title: Global sections of residue-point pullback are tensor of the stalk
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and x a point with residue field kappa(x) [def-weil-residue-field]. The functor from O_X-module sheaves that first pulls back along i_x:Spec kappa(x)→X [def-pc-module-pullback], then takes global sections and restricts scalars along GammaSpecIso inverse, is naturally isomorphic to the composite of the module stalk functor at x [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] and extension of scalars along the residue map O_X,x→kappa(x). This holds for all module sheaves, without quasi-coherence or flatness.

source.place: Tag 0098, Lemma 6.26.4, specialized to a residue-field point with global sections on a singleton spectrum

proof.text: Let y be the unique point of Spec kappa(x). Every open neighborhood of y equals the whole space. The global germ map therefore identifies sections of any module sheaf with its stalk; its inverse sends a germ to the global representative, uniquely since every representative neighborhood is the whole space. The ring germ likewise identifies the ring stalk with global sections. Transport scalars by GammaSpecIso to kappa(x).

Apply the natural tensorPullback stalk isomorphism at y. The equality i_x(y)=x and the equality of its stalk map, under the preceding ring identification, with the residue map identify the right side with kappa(x) tensor over O_X,x the original stalk. Those identities follow by applying both maps to germs of sections in the definition of fromSpecResidueField.

Compose with the global germ identification to give the required linear isomorphism. Its forward map sends a pure tensor a tensor m to a times the restricted germ, and its inverse is the inverse stalk tensor map followed by the inverse global germ map. Their inverse identities and linearity follow from the constituent isomorphisms. The naturality of germs and tensorPullback stalks gives naturality in every module sheaf, hence a natural isomorphism of the two functors.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_residuePullback_globalSections_iso (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) :
    Nonempty
      (Modules.tensorPullback (X.fromSpecResidueField x) ⋙
          (SheafOfModules.evaluation
            (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace) (op ⊤) ⋙
              ModuleCat.restrictScalars (ΓSpecIso (X.residueField x)).inv.hom) ≅
        RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x ⋙
          ModuleCat.extendScalars (IsLocalRing.residue (X.presheaf.stalk x)))
